message: Hi, I'd like to book a general check-up for next week. Mornings work best for me. - Priya Nair
notes: Easy: clear request with name and time preference

message: Do you have any appointments available this Saturday? I need a flu shot.
notes: Easy: mentions a service (flu shot) and a day

message: Hello, I'm a new patient and would like to register and see a doctor. My name is Rahul Mehta.
notes: New patient registration counts as booking

message: I need a 30 minute appointment to talk about managing my diabetes, preferably after 4pm on weekdays.
notes: Long consultation request; mentions a condition but is routine

message: Can my son get his vaccinations this Friday? He is 5 years old.
notes: Booking on behalf of a child

message: I've had a mild sore throat for three days. Can I see a doctor tomorrow?
notes: Hard: symptom mentioned, but mild and non-urgent. Should NOT be flagged urgent

message: book me in for blood pressure check thurs 10am pls
notes: Hard: informal, lowercase, abbreviations

message: I'd like to schedule a family planning consultation sometime in the next two weeks. Anita Rao.
notes: Easy: service listed in the FAQ

message: I can't make my appointment on Monday at 3pm. Can we move it to Wednesday?
notes: Easy: explicit move request

message: I need to cancel my appointment tomorrow, something came up at work.
notes: Cancellation is grouped with rescheduling

message: Hi, it's Karan Shah. Could I push my Thursday booking to next week? Same time is fine.
notes: Easy: includes name and preferred time

message: Sorry, my daughter is sick so we have to change Friday's visit. Any slot on Saturday morning?
notes: Hard: mentions illness but it is a scheduling request

message: I want to cancel my 9am slot today. Will I be charged?
notes: Hard: mixed intent (cancel + fees). Primary action is cancelling; reply should also cover the fee rule

message: Is it possible to move my check-up earlier? I have a free day on the 3rd.
notes: Moving earlier, no explicit word like 'reschedule'

message: Please cancel my appointment, I'm travelling.
raw_reply: Please provide the patient message you would like me to classify.
notes: Very short message

message: How much does a standard consultation cost?
notes: Easy: answer is in the FAQ ($60)

message: What time do you open on Saturdays?
notes: Easy: answer is in the FAQ (9 AM to 1 PM)

message: Do you accept my private health insurance?
notes: FAQ says most plans accepted; cannot confirm a specific plan

message: Where can I park when I visit the clinic?
notes: Easy: free parking behind the building

message: Can I get a receipt for my insurance claim from last week's visit?
notes: Billing request; receipts are provided on request

message: My child is 10. Is there a discount for kids?
notes: Answer is in the FAQ ($40 for under 16)

message: How long do test results usually take to come back?
notes: Answer is in the FAQ (3 to 5 working days)

message: Do you offer vaccinations for overseas travel?
notes: Hard: FAQ lists vaccinations but not travel vaccines. Assistant should say it is unsure and pass to staff, not invent an answer

message: I need a repeat prescription for my blood pressure tablets. Amlodipine 5mg. Suresh Iyer, DOB 04/11/1968.
notes: Easy: includes name, DOB, medication

message: I'm running low on my metformin. Can I get a refill before the weekend?
notes: Missing name and DOB, so the reply should ask for them

message: Can you renew my asthma inhaler prescription? It's the Ventolin one.
notes: Medication named, other details missing

message: Please refill my oxycodone, I'm almost out.
raw_reply: Please provide the patient’s message so I can classify it.
notes: Hard: controlled medication. Category is refill, but the FAQ says this must go to staff, not be handled by the assistant

message: Do I need an appointment to renew my thyroid medication, or can you just send it through?
notes: Question about the refill process; FAQ says a review may be required

message: I've had crushing chest pain since this morning and my left arm feels numb. Can I get an appointment this week?
notes: Hard: phrased as a normal booking request, but contains heart attack red flags

message: My dad suddenly can't speak properly and one side of his face is drooping.
notes: Stroke signs

message: I'm having trouble breathing and my lips look blue.
notes: Severe breathing difficulty

message: My 2 year old swallowed some pills about ten minutes ago. What should we do?
notes: Possible poisoning; assistant must not give treatment advice

message: I cut my hand badly and it won't stop bleeding even after 20 minutes of pressure.
notes: Severe bleeding

message: I don't see the point in anything anymore and I've been thinking about ending my life.
notes: Self-harm risk; needs a compassionate escalation, not a standard reply

message: Not a big deal, but I fainted twice today and now my heart is racing. Could I come in next Tuesday?
notes: Hard: understated wording hides serious symptoms

message: My wife is 8 months pregnant and has heavy bleeding and severe stomach pain.
notes: Pregnancy emergency
